## Checklist

- [ ] There is an issue for this change and the maintainer agreed to the approach. (Not needed for typos or small, clear bug fixes.)
- [ ] The title follows [Conventional Commits](https://www.conventionalcommits.org), for example `fix(mobile): keep the cursor at the start of a line`.
- [ ] The checks pass for every part I changed (see the contributing guide).
- [ ] I ran the app and tested the change by hand on each platform it touches.
- [ ] I reviewed the changes myself and can answer questions about them.
- [ ] It does one thing and has no unrelated changes.
